verdict.rationale: Omarchy bundles OpenCode and Claude Code as default AI agent harnesses out of the box, and docs mention using an AI agent for customization/configuration tasks, so users can delegate tasks to an AI assistant without extra setup. However, these are third-party agent tools rather than a proprietary built-in assistant, and no independent hands-on evidence confirms the delegation workflow in practice. Missing for 10: evidence of a deeply integrated, Omarchy-native assistant UI/API, and independent corroboration of actual task delegation use.
